Messages.Author: Darrin Yancey
Messages.Body:
Does enchant kindred stay on the vampire? Or is it gone at the end of the
round?

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
dya...@news.dorsai.org (Darrin Yancey) writes:

>Does enchant kindred stay on the vampire? Or is it gone at the end of the
>round?

All Action cards (with the <> symbol on them) are burned when the action
is blocked or when the action is successfully completed, unless (as
always), the card says otherwise (army of rats, blood bond, etc.)

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Assuming you mean superior Enchant Kindred, it simply adds 2 blood to
an appropriate uncontrolled vampire, and is then finished.
